user.title: Connect to Solar of Things over Bluetooth
user.description: Use the BLE address of the WiFi Relabs/Siseli data logger and its 32-character BLE AES key. Close Solar of Things proximal monitoring while testing because the logger may allow only one active BLE client.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the inverter over BLE. Confirm the address/key, Bluetooth range, and that the Solar of Things app is not holding the connection.
error.invalid_aes_key: The BLE AES key must be exactly 32 hexadecimal characters.

abort.already_configured: This Bluetooth device is already configured.
